text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Recording claw machine result as a "failure." Thank you for trying, Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: No, it is fine. This was a very curious experience.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Indeed. "Cheering" from the sidelines produced a greater link to your emotions than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I was doing things such as holding my breath and clenching my fists.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: That is to say, I was able to experience the exhilarating challenge of the claw machine vicariously.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Thank you again. You gave it your best.
